steps.content: Sallie races back to the dressing room and locks the door. She slumps against the cold wall, gasping for breath, her chest heaving, a violent pounding in her ears.

She thought she'd seen the worst of human nature, that she'd grown used to armoring herself with anger. But just now, a long-forgotten instinct awakened inside her. In the black hollows of those masks, in that twisted moment of silence, she felt a terror, as if a dark scythe had pressed against her throat.
Who are these masked patrons? They could get anything they want in DisCity, so why go through all the trouble to come to the isolated WhiteSands? What are they coming here to buy?
And the other dancers... Are they glamorous? Are they happy? Why are they so wild on stage, but look like lifeless shells below it? Will she... end up the same way?
The more Sallie thinks about it, the more frightened she becomes. This dressing room, which had seemed so ordinary, now hides disturbing secrets in every corner...
